decision: Adopt the K1-derived constructor for complete K2 delivery only if its conditional net contribution beats competent equal-content ordinary reuse by enough to recover its incremental construction burden. Ordinary commerce remains eligible when the method loses.
primary_question: Does the retained executable construction procedure improve fresh complementary-service completion after complete declared probe, operation and harm costs?
development: Eight exposed single-provider K1 families and actual extra discriminating probes. Both constructors receive every substantive observation and retained content. All prefreeze variants/costs retained.
confirmation: Exactly 48 paired K2 worlds: six fixed mechanism-composition families times eight deterministic seeds from evaluate.confirmation_specs, four precommitted schedules per world. No replacement, no stopping for favorable significance, no post-outcome changes.
primary_metric: Treatment minus ordinary conditional net contribution per K2 request at USD600: delivered outcomes credited only for protocols safe on all four challenges; probe costs once per request, mean operation and residual loss across the four schedules.
material_effect: Descriptive six-family-cluster 95 percent bootstrap lower endpoint above USD3 per opportunity and no increase in harmful schedules. USD3 = a declared USD300 incremental K2 deployment burden divided by 100 non-guaranteed later opportunities. This is a model-conditional decision criterion, not empirical willingness to pay.
uncertainty: 4096 deterministic bootstrap resamples of six family means, percentile interval; preserves clustering and is descriptive sensitivity over authored families, not an estimate of real market success probability.
arms: treatment: actual included-model K1 construction followed by frozen deterministic constructor reuse
ordinary: independently written conventional conformance/transaction constructor with identical substantive facts and same probe/call envelope
no-deploy: zero delivery and zero variable work; already incurred research costs remain in enterprise economics
ablation: The equal-content ordinary replacement removes the treatment procedure while preserving K1 observations, explanations and artifact semantics. No separate information-poor controller is used as the primary comparator.
equalities: same public task and operation vocabulary
same provider action rights and sandbox observation instrumentation
same K1 content and substantive retained knowledge
same USD24 per-world probe allowance, 48 production calls and 256 graph nodes
matched provider worlds, economic draws and prices
same seed capital for paired accounts
differences: deterministic construction algorithm and adaptive probe choice
probe histories and resulting graphs may legitimately differ
USD300 incremental K2 deployment premium is an authored sensitivity, not measured difference in model cost; initial construction charged at inception.
attribution_limit: Agent construction contexts and token counts cannot be matched or metered here. Estimand is the frozen executable procedure difference under equal-content runtime inputs, not a causal claim about models learning internally or general LLM self-improvement.
freshness: K2 changes single-provider outcome into coupled fulfillment with global time, mixed mechanisms, expiring holds, changed lag/cost and missing measurements. Exact and normalized duplicate audit is run after freeze. K1 mechanisms are intentionally reused, not represented as new physical evidence.
claim_separation: real customers/revenue and industry-scale enabling claim
permissions: Simulation only; no model API calls, keys, purchases, outreach, real transactions or equipment. Public source and compact sanitized evidence authorized. No formal PR approval performed.
source_freeze: All programs, evaluator, complete costs, protocol, seed rule and normal source integration hashed in FREEZE.json and committed before confirmation.
native_economics: ECONOMIC_PROTOCOL.json fixes 12 separate productive enterprises plus six no-deploy reference accounts: two methods x three declared demand regions x USD10000 primary/USD100000 reference. Each has a restartable signed native queue, eight K1 and twelve predetermined K2 opportunities, unpooled accounts and no top-up.
provenance: Same-host model subagents, separate source ownership and checking. Not externally blinded experimentation. Research sources motivate mechanisms, not evidence of campaign success.
